تستكتبون (form X)
# تَسْتَكْتِبُونَ (tastaktibūna) /tas.tak.ti.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكْتَبَ (istaktaba)
# تُسْتَكْتَبُونَ (tustaktabūna) /tus.tak.ta.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَكْتَبَ (istaktaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
